Series: Except for the MPBZ moment post base, standard post bases (ABU, ABA, ABW, CBSQ, CBSTQ) do NOT provide adequate rotational resistance to prevent members from rotating about the base and are not recommended for unbraced freestanding structures (fences, unbraced trellises, carports) without top lateral bracing.
MPBZ Simultaneous Combined Loading Interaction: (P_design / P_allow) + (M_design / M_allow) + (V_design / V_allow) <= 1.0, where P is either Uplift or Download.
Post cap lateral loads (F1) are valid only when either the post or the beam is laterally braced by other means (e.g., diaphragm, knee braces, or MPBZ moment base).
For spliced beams on CC / CCQ column caps, maximum allowable download per spliced beam is 0.5 * Allowable Download, and one beam load shall not exceed 2.0x the adjacent spliced beam load.
